friendly_name: The activation set: ActivationConfig and the reserved activation operations
purpose_context: ADR-0020 makes active charters a stored, top-level resource. Core's deny-list work codes against the contract now, so ADR-0022 D5 puts the activation set in the first 0.x minor after 0.1.0: closed schemas, every operation declared in full and reserved, refusal codes, conditional headers, lint rules and scenarios that pin each reserved operation.
purpose_tldr: Declare the activation document and every activation operation in the charter contract, answering 501 until built, so core can code its deny-list against it.
